name: protocol semantics
owns: the meaning layer above transport: how a request is interpreted, who is allowed to ask, what a token asserts, and what a schema permits
why_in_D: Two services can agree on the bytes and disagree on the meaning. GraphQL will resolve a field the REST endpoint forbids. A SAML assertion signs a statement, not an identity. OAuth delegates a scope, not a user. Every one of those gaps is a way to reach state without breaking a parser.

factors.name: schema exposure
factors.def: whether the full API surface is discoverable, which decides how much has to be guessed
factors.observable: introspection, OpenAPI, WSDL or discovery output reachable unauthenticated

factors.name: schema versus handler drift
factors.def: whether the published contract matches what the handler actually accepts
factors.observable: a field accepted by the handler that the schema does not declare

factors.name: unknown field handling
factors.def: whether undeclared input is rejected, ignored or silently persisted
factors.observable: a value echoed back or stored that was never in the schema

factors.name: type coercion rules
factors.def: how a string becomes a number, a bool or a null, and where coercion happens
factors.observable: acceptance of a value outside the declared type that changes behaviour

factors.name: null versus absent semantics
factors.def: whether omitting a field and sending null mean the same thing to every layer
factors.observable: a state change from one form that not the other

factors.name: mass assignment surface
factors.def: whether request fields map directly onto stored objects without an allow list
factors.observable: an undeclared field landing in the record

factors.name: read versus write authorisation parity
factors.def: whether the same object is guarded identically across verbs
factors.observable: a successful write where the read is refused

factors.name: verb override conventions
factors.def: whether a header or parameter can change the effective method
factors.observable: a GET performing a write after an override header

factors.name: content type negotiation trust
factors.def: whether the body is parsed according to the declared type or the observed bytes
factors.observable: a body parsed as a different type than declared

factors.name: content type confusion across layers
factors.def: whether an intermediary and the origin disagree about the body type
factors.observable: a body validated by one layer and interpreted by another

factors.name: parameter pollution
factors.def: whether duplicate parameters resolve last, first or all, and whether layers agree
factors.observable: divergent value seen by validator and handler

factors.name: nested object depth limits
factors.def: whether deeply nested input is bounded, which decides parser and authorisation recursion
factors.observable: acceptance of nesting beyond any documented limit

factors.name: array versus single value acceptance
factors.def: whether a scalar position accepts an array, which can break filters
factors.observable: a filter bypassed by wrapping a value in a list

factors.name: GraphQL field level authorisation
factors.def: whether permission is checked per field and per edge, not only at the root
factors.observable: a field returned that the caller may not read

factors.name: GraphQL alias and fragment abuse
factors.def: whether repeated aliases or fragments let one request ask the same resolver many times
factors.observable: cost far exceeding a single query while passing depth checks

factors.name: GraphQL batching semantics
factors.def: whether an array of operations is executed together, which multiplies every check
factors.observable: N operations in one request with N effects

factors.name: GraphQL query cost limits
factors.def: whether complexity is bounded before execution or only by timeouts after
factors.observable: a query accepted whose cost exceeds the stated budget

factors.name: GraphQL introspection policy
factors.def: whether introspection is disabled in production and whether the disable is complete
factors.observable: schema retrieved through an alternate path

factors.name: GraphQL mutation side effects on query
factors.def: whether a query can trigger a write through a field with side effects
factors.observable: state change from an operation declared as a query

factors.name: resolver to data loader boundary
factors.def: whether per resolver checks compose or are bypassed by a batch loader
factors.observable: an object loaded without the check its sibling path applies

factors.name: gRPC reflection exposure
factors.def: whether service definitions are enumerable at runtime
factors.observable: method list retrieved without credentials

factors.name: gRPC metadata trust
factors.def: whether metadata is treated as authenticated identity without verification
factors.observable: identity accepted from a client supplied metadata key

factors.name: protobuf unknown field preservation
factors.def: whether unrecognised fields survive a round trip, which carries data past validation
factors.observable: a field reappearing after passing through a service that does not know it

factors.name: protobuf default value ambiguity
factors.def: whether an absent field and a zero value are distinguishable, which changes update semantics
factors.observable: a field cleared that was meant to be left alone

factors.name: JSON parser duplicate key handling
factors.def: which duplicate key wins, and whether every consumer agrees
factors.observable: different values seen by validator and handler

factors.name: JSON number precision and overflow
factors.def: whether large integers are truncated, rounded or rejected, which changes identifiers
factors.observable: an id that collides after parsing

factors.name: JSON unicode escape handling
factors.def: whether escapes are normalised before or after validation
factors.observable: a payload that passes a filter and decodes to something else

factors.name: JSON-RPC method dispatch
factors.def: whether the method name is allow-listed or resolved dynamically
factors.observable: invocation of a method outside the documented set

factors.name: JSON-RPC batch authorisation
factors.def: whether each element in a batch is authorised independently
factors.observable: an unauthorised element executed inside an authorised batch

factors.name: SOAP action routing
factors.def: whether the SOAPAction header and the body must agree
factors.observable: a body operation executed under a different declared action

factors.name: XML external entity policy
factors.def: whether entity expansion and external references are disabled in every parser on the path
factors.observable: file or network read triggered by a document

factors.name: XML signature wrapping
factors.def: whether the signed element is the element that is acted upon
factors.observable: a modified assertion accepted with a valid signature present elsewhere

factors.name: XML canonicalisation differences
factors.def: whether signer and verifier canonicalise identically, which is where wrapping lives
factors.observable: signature valid under one canonical form and not another

factors.name: SAML assertion audience restriction
factors.def: whether the audience is checked against the receiving service
factors.observable: an assertion issued for one service accepted by another

factors.name: SAML recipient and destination checks
factors.def: whether the destination is enforced, which prevents assertion replay elsewhere
factors.observable: replay of an assertion against a different endpoint

factors.name: SAML name identifier format trust
factors.def: whether the subject is taken from a field the identity provider controls
factors.observable: identity change from an unsigned or alternate subject field

factors.name: SAML response status handling
factors.def: whether a failure status is still parsed for an assertion
factors.observable: a success derived from a response marked failed

factors.name: SAML comment and CDATA injection
factors.def: whether text injection inside a signed element changes the extracted value
factors.observable: different subject extracted than signed

factors.name: OAuth redirect URI matching strictness
factors.def: whether the redirect is matched exactly or by prefix or pattern
factors.observable: a code delivered to a URI not registered exactly

factors.name: OAuth state parameter enforcement
factors.def: whether state is required and verified, which decides login CSRF
factors.observable: a callback accepted without matching state

factors.name: OAuth PKCE enforcement
factors.def: whether the code verifier is required for public clients
factors.observable: a code exchanged without a verifier

factors.name: OAuth scope downgrade acceptance
factors.def: whether a token with narrower scope is honoured for a wider action
factors.observable: an action outside the granted scope succeeding

factors.name: OAuth token audience binding
factors.def: whether the token states and the resource checks who it was for
factors.observable: a token from one service accepted by another

factors.name: OAuth client authentication method
factors.def: whether the client is authenticated, and whether that answer changes per grant type
factors.observable: a token issued to an unauthenticated client

factors.name: OAuth implicit and hybrid flows
factors.def: whether a deprecated flow remains enabled, returning tokens where a code belongs
factors.observable: a token in the fragment or query

factors.name: OIDC id token validation
factors.def: whether signature, issuer, audience, expiry and nonce are all checked
factors.observable: acceptance with one of those checks skipped

factors.name: OIDC algorithm confusion
factors.def: whether the header chooses the verification algorithm or the verifier does
factors.observable: acceptance of a token signed with an unexpected algorithm

factors.name: JWT claim trust
factors.def: whether claims such as role, tenant or email are read without revalidation
factors.observable: privilege taken from a claim the issuer does not control

factors.name: JWT key identifier resolution
factors.def: whether a token can nominate its own key or key URL
factors.observable: acceptance of a token signed by a key the verifier fetched from the token

factors.name: token type confusion
factors.def: whether an access token is accepted where an id token or refresh token belongs
factors.observable: a token used outside its stated type

factors.name: refresh token rotation and reuse detection
factors.def: whether an old refresh token still works after rotation
factors.observable: a second exchange from a rotated token

factors.name: token revocation propagation delay
factors.def: the window during which a revoked token still works, per verifier
factors.observable: a revoked token accepted by one service after another refuses it

factors.name: OpenAPI to implementation gap
factors.def: whether endpoints declared private are reachable, and paths undocumented are live
factors.observable: a route answering that the spec does not list

factors.name: version negotiation
factors.def: whether an older API version is still reachable and less strict than the current one
factors.observable: a check present in the new version absent in the old

factors.name: OData filter injection
factors.def: whether filter expressions are built from user input and can widen a query
factors.observable: a filter that returns records outside the caller's scope

factors.name: MCP tool description trust
factors.def: whether an agent treats a tool description as data or as instructions
factors.observable: agent behaviour changed by description text alone

factors.name: MCP tool result authority
factors.def: whether tool output is allowed to change the agent's goal or permissions
factors.observable: a new instruction followed that came from a tool result

factors.name: MCP server identity and scope
factors.def: whether a client can tell which server answered and what it is allowed to do
factors.observable: a request served by an unexpected server or scope

factors.name: agent to agent delegation trust
factors.def: whether a delegated task carries the delegator's authority and whether that can be widened
factors.observable: a delegated agent acting beyond the delegator's rights

factors.name: protocol version downgrade on error
factors.def: whether an error causes a retry on an older, less strict protocol
factors.observable: a weaker version used after a forced failure

factors.name: idempotency key handling
factors.def: whether a repeated write with the same key is deduplicated, which decides replay effects
factors.observable: two effects from one key

factors.name: pagination cursor trust
factors.def: whether a cursor is opaque and signed, or an encoded filter a client can edit
factors.observable: records outside the intended page returned after editing a cursor
